Forest limit z_e=q lambda_e followed by q->0 retains all positive R0 terms and bridge probabilities lambda/(1+lambda). An independent exact rational exhaustive test on a triangle--bridge--triangle cactus verified all 225 ordered nontrivial pair comparisons, including strictness/equality, at q=1/7,1/2,1,3 and the forest law (1125 comparisons).
